messages:
kevin: Heads up — preflight for release/2025-04 finished. Prompt/eval suite flagged a regression on the summarizer route. Holding the rollout until we decide on a route-level action. See results below.

deploy-bot: preflight report (release/2025-04)
- prompt-suite v12: overall PASS
- route: summarizer -> FAIL (ROUGE-L delta -6.2% vs baseline; threshold -5%)
- route: summarizer -> hallucination_rate +3.1% (threshold +2%)
Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/rls-2025-04-1234

maria: Which specific prompt families failed? quick examples would help triage.

kevin: news-summary and notes-compact are the worst. Short snippet from failing run: 
```
input: "TL;DR meeting about Q2 roadmap"
baseline: "Decided to prioritize infra and reduce scope for X."
candidate: "Team agreed to delay Q2 and hire two more PMs."
```
Key issue: hallucinated actions and missing constraints.

tara: Proposal: don't block the entire release. Route-level mitigation: pin the summarizer route to rwd-sum@v3.2 (previous stable), let other routes continue. Need ops to apply routing pin + approval from oncall.

ops-bot: route-pin available. Command (dry-run):
```
/deploy pin --route summarizer --model rwd-sum@v3.2 --reason "preflight summarizer regression"
```
Requires approval from @oncall to execute in prod.

oncall: I see the diffs. Approve emergency route pin for summarizer to reduce user-facing risk. Please attach rollback plan.

kevin: Approved by @oncall. Ops, please apply the pin and pause canary for summarizer. We'll open a triage ticket and run a bisect on the recent quantization + tokenizer changes.

maria: Starting bisect now. Running smaller prompt families first to isolate commit. ETA ~45m. I'll update thread with checkpoints.

tara: I'll update the release notes: adding a "limited hold" section for summarizer + the mitigation steps and patch window. PR to docs coming in 15m.

deploy-bot: Action taken: canary disabled for summarizer route, routing pinned to rwd-sum@v3.2 (applied by ops-bot). Canary percentage set to 0%.

kevin: Decision summary: hold full rollout for summarizer only. Route pinned to stable model. Triage window 1h (from first_message_ts). If we can't identify and fix the regression within the window, we will skip summarizer changes for this release and ship the rest.

maria: Ack — will post bisect results. If bisect points to quantization, propose reverting quantization-for-sum commit and re-run evals.

tara: Noted — release notes draft updated with the hold + routing pin + rollback steps. Will include the CI link and the command used for the pin.

kevin: Thanks team. Keep updates concise in this thread so release manager can close when resolved.
